llm.summary: NWE became dead money and underperformed SPY despite a clean process and mixed cause assignment. Its co-occurrence with other Utilities disappointments supports a shared conditioning hypothesis, not a proven sector cause.
llm.root_cause: NWE became dead money and underperformed SPY despite a clean process and mixed cause assignment. Its co-occurrence with other Utilities disappointments supports a shared conditioning hypothesis, not a proven sector cause.
llm.lesson: The execution organ remained clean, while the Utilities-rotation and macro-regime books may have failed to distinguish a low-propulsion environment.
llm.engines_credit: The process book is not a laggard; the sector and regime books are the principal research targets pending contemporaneous evidence.

causal_chain.mechanism: Weak capital rotation into Utilities may have constrained relative performance.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Strong Utilities breadth and inflows at entry would contradict the rotation hypothesis.

causal_chain.mechanism: NWE did not exhibit enough idiosyncratic propulsion to overcome the possible sector headwind.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Outperformance versus Utilities peers would shift the explanation toward market-relative sector lag.

causal_chain.mechanism: Entry-date Utilities regime conditioning may have identified a poor environment for the setup.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Evaluate identical setup types across strong and weak Utilities regime cells without altering gates.

alternate_explanations: NWE-specific developments may have caused the dead-money path.
A broad risk-on rotation away from defensives may explain the relative lag.

signal_hypotheses.measurement: Measure Utilities breadth and relative momentum against cyclical sectors using only contemporaneous data.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Weak defensive rotation should be associated with more Utilities dead-money outcomes.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Utilities outcomes are independent of the defensive rotation state.
